summary: Runtime provider registry (.z-harness/providers.json) resolving consultant/reviewer roles to CLI invocation descriptors, layered under a TOML role-runtime override axis with legacy [models]/providers.json.roles fallbacks, alias resolution, and per-dispatch auth/PATH preflight.

entry_points.summary: Thin wrapper (exec python3 resolve-provider.py) used by reviewer/consultant agents.
Consult-off sentinel, config load/merge/validate, TOML override path, legacy fallbacks, descriptor output.
Reads models.<role>, validates provider and compose_argv precondition, enforces cross-path distinctness.
Legacy roles map lookup with alias substitution, PATH check, and argv composition.
Per-key global/repo merge for providers, roles, aliases; emits provider_shadowed.
Renders model_arg_template with effective model; legacy null template returns args_template.
Validates PATH, argv/model composition, and OMP auth readiness; emits provider_preflight_ok/failed.
Resolves peer consultant's canonical provider across TOML/legacy paths without alias telemetry, for distinctness checks.
PATH probe for known CLIs; returns proposed v1 registry without writing.
Draft 7 schema accepting registry version 1 and 2; kind enum cli|sdk.
Handles plaintext none before JSON parsing and logs skipped provider resolution.
Compatibility shim: reads stdin prompt, invokes omp -p --no-session --no-rules --model <provider/model> <prompt>, classifies auth/session failures, optional explicit native CLI fallback.

invariants: Resolution priority inside main(): Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off sentinel check first -> config.toml [roles.<command/default>.<role>].runtime override second -> legacy config.toml [models.<role>] third -> legacy providers.json.roles map fourth.

consultant_primary and consultant_secondary must resolve to distinct provider names regardless of which binding path (TOML role-runtime, legacy [models], or legacy roles map) each uses. _peek_consultant_provider checks all paths when enforcing distinctness from _resolve_config_provider_selection / check_consultant_distinctness.

When Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off, resolve-provider.py prints the plaintext sentinel 'none' (exit 0) for roles consultant_primary, consultant_secondary, and reviewer — before any config file is loaded (main(), lines 910-913).
The sentinel 'none' is a plaintext string, not JSON. Any consumer that receives 'none' must skip JSON parsing and must not dispatch to an external model CLI.

Repo-local config overrides user-global config per-key across providers, roles, and aliases sections. Shadowing emits provider_shadowed event and stderr warning, de-duped per parent process (PPID-keyed stamp file).
Schema version field must be 1 or 2; any other value causes exit 2. Version 1 is upgraded in-memory to v2 automatically and memoized per (process, file path).

Every provider entry in the merged config is validated on every resolver call, not just the entry being resolved (kind, command, args_template, stdin, timeout_s, model_label, model_arg_template, model_env_var, default_model, auth_env types).
discover-providers.py never writes files and outputs v1 format JSON — all writes go through /z-providers-discover with explicit user confirmation and atomic tmpfile+rename.

compose_argv raises ValueError (not sys.exit) when no model can be resolved from effective_model or provider default_model. When model_arg_template is null (v1 legacy), returns args_template immediately without model resolution.

providers.json.roles is the legacy fallback for role binding, below both TOML role-runtime override and legacy [models.<role>]. Using providers.json.roles emits legacy_provider_roles_used on every lookup through that path.

.z-harness/providers.json v2 ships both old names (codex/gemini/claude/cursor/agy) and new -cli names (codex-cli/gemini-cli/claude-cli/cursor-cli/agy-cli) as first-class provider entries; aliases map provides forward-compat without deleting old entries.

resolve() unconditionally passes is_legacy=True when resolving from the roles section of providers.json, so legacy_provider_roles_used fires for every role lookup through that path regardless of alias involvement.

_preflight_provider runs on every resolved descriptor (TOML override, [models] override, or legacy roles path) and validates: role bound -> provider defined -> command on PATH -> argv/model composes -> auth ready (env var present, or OMP omp token <provider> succeeds).
OMP provider entries are consult-provider compatibility and do not imply OmpAdapter support or native command tiers.
scripts/omp-consult.sh is the only documented --no-rules --no-session OMP path; native OMP command dispatch must bypass it.

omp-consult.sh classifies stderr into auth/session failures (_is_omp_auth_or_session_failure) vs generic failures; auth/session failures always fail loud (exit 3, provider_preflight_failed) and never silently degrade to --fallback, even when a fallback command was configured.
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off bypasses config loading and the distinctness check entirely — setting it is sufficient; no providers.json change needed.

log-providers.sh checks for 'none' at line 34 BEFORE calling any python JSON parse. Previously, receiving 'none' caused json.load to crash. The guard ensures a clean provider_resolution_skipped event is emitted instead.

Consumer contract for 'none': /z-plan skips Phase 3 and Phase 7 external consults; /z-execute routes its reviewer gate to a self-reviewer subagent (agents/self-reviewer.md) that never calls resolve-provider or any external CLI.

Schema at runtime/contract/provider.schema.json permits kind='sdk' and optional auth_env/session_resumable/allow_cross_vendor_env, but resolve-provider.py validates only kind='cli' — SDK entries pass schema but cause exit 2 if resolved.
Z_HARNESS_REPO_PROVIDERS env var overrides repo config path entirely, bypassing git-based discovery.
Shadow de-dup stamp file is keyed on PPID, not PID — warning fires once per parent process tree, not once per subshell.
Role with no bound provider causes immediate halt with actionable error pointing to /z-providers-discover.
CLI not on PATH causes exit 1 even if the config entry is otherwise valid.
_upgrade_v1_to_v2 is memoized per (process, file path) via module-level _v1_upgrade_emitted set — double-emission is prevented when both global and repo configs are v1.

_resolve_models_override enforces consultant distinctness across ALL combinations of TOML role-runtime and legacy paths via _peek_consultant_provider, which checks the TOML role-runtime binding first, then [models] override, then legacy roles map, when looking up the peer consultant's provider.

_check_compose_argv_precondition only fires when a config override (TOML role-runtime or [models.<role>]) is set AND the resolved provider has a non-null model_arg_template. In that case default_model must be set or resolution fails with a fail-loud message.

aliases section IS used by resolve() via _apply_aliases — it is not merely informational. The shipped aliases map covers six entries: codex, gemini, claude, cursor, agy -> their -cli canonical names, plus omp-gemini -> omp-antigravity-pro. Old alias names are transparently resolved; provider_alias_used is emitted once per (process, old-name).
When the roles map in providers.json is the active binding path, both legacy_provider_roles_used AND (if an alias is matched) provider_alias_used are emitted — two distinct events for one resolution.
_alias_used_emitted memoization set is module-level; alias dedup survives multiple resolve() calls within the same process but resets on new process invocations.

cursor-cli and agy-cli are the only shipped providers with non-null model_arg_template (['--model', '{model}']) and a default_model set — all other shipped providers use null model_arg_template (v1 legacy mode).
discover-providers.py KNOWN_CLIS still uses old v1-style names (codex, gemini, claude, ollama, agy, gpt) and outputs version:1. This is intentional — the v1 output is upgraded transparently on load.
Do not use omp-gemini/omp-codex provider success as evidence for OMP native host parity; provider dispatch tests only cover consultant compatibility.

.z-harness/providers.json roles binds consultant_primary=omp-antigravity-pro (not the older omp-gemini name); omp-gemini now exists only as an alias entry, added in commit bbe0bb0 alongside broader model-routing/preflight-telemetry additions to resolve-provider.py (+482 lines).

omp-consult.sh writes stderr to a mktemp file and greps it for auth/session phrasing before deciding fail-loud vs fallback; it strips the temp file unconditionally, so no stderr content is ever logged verbatim except inside the classified provider_preflight_failed reason string.
